name: A B INFOTECH - PDF Sign & All-in-One Power Suite
changelog: Resolved Android app startup crash with Android 14 (API 34) Foreground Service type compliance
Bundled complete offline Web Signing Studio inside APK with PDF.js engine and visual signature placer
Added pure Java CCID USB OTG token driver support across all 4 Indian tokens (HYP2003, mToken, ProxKey, InnaIT)
Enhanced Port 5000 background local HTTP API server with CORS preflight and asset caching
Fixed update download resiliency with direct browser download option and SSL certificate fallbacks
Updated multi-OS download portal (index.html) with Android APK card and live git version badge
